strategies.name: NFP straddle of the 4-hour pre-release range, target = range

strategies.name: Cowabunga: 4H trend + 15m EMA5/10, RSI9, stoch, MACD, 1R, out 16:00 NY

strategies.name: EMA 5/13 cross + VWAP + ADX>20, stop at the cross, 2R

strategies.name: Pivot liquidity sweep + momentum candle + EMA200, 1:2

strategies.name: Toto SBL: EMA 50/100/200 aligned, swing sweep in killzones, 2R

strategies.name: NY first 5m candle break, 1m FVG retest + engulfing, 3R

strategies.name: CPI anchored-VWAP retest after the spike, confirmation candle, 1:2

strategies.name: Doji sandwich continuation, stop at the doji, stochastic exit
strategies.rules: 4H: large candle, doji, large candle same direction -> enter at the 4th candle open / stop beyond the doji / exit when stochastic overbought (oversold for shorts)

strategies.name: VWAP cross + MACD flip, exit on the MACD cross back, 1-minute

strategies.name: ALMA 21 + Stochastic 21/1/3 cross of 20/80, 1-minute
strategies.rules: 1m: close above ALMA(21,0.85,6) with stoch(21,1,3) crossing above 20 (short: below ALMA, cross below 80) / stop beyond nearest swing / take profit at the opposite stochastic zone

strategies.name: RSI(4) 80/20 + Bollinger touch, target the opposite band, 1-minute

strategies.name: Keltner scalp: SMA89 + MACD 5/34/5 turn + stochastic, 1-minute

strategies.name: EURUSD 5m TEMA21 vs SMA300 + BB width + CCI -110/160, CCI 210 exit

strategies.name: Bollinger + RSI 30/70 + Stochastic 5/3/3 scalp, mid-band exit, 5-minute

strategies.name: Admiral Keltner 50/10/2.75 re-entry + Stochastic 14/7/3, target the middle, M15

strategies.name: DAX first 5-minute bar direction at 09:05, 5/10 points, flat 17:30

strategies.name: Hull Suite 55 + DI cross, swing stop, 1:1, 1-minute

strategies.name: EMA 50/100 cross + pullback + Stochastic 20/80, swing stop, 10-pip target, 1-minute

strategies.name: Gold 5m: 4H EMA200 trend, EMA50 pullback + engulfing/hammer + RSI 40, 2R, 13-17 GMT

strategies.name: XAU 55-MA high/low channel break + Heikin-Ashi colour, previous-candle stop, 1.5R
strategies.rules: M1/M5 / break above the 55-MA of highs with a green Heikin-Ashi candle (below the 55-MA of lows with a red one) / stop beyond the previous candle / target 1:1.5

strategies.name: ES 5-minute ORB, stop the other edge, target half the range, range <= 0.55%, no Tuesdays
strategies.rules: 5m range 09:30-09:35 ET on ES / break above (long) or below (short), skip ranges > 0.55% and Tuesdays / stop at the opposite edge / target 50% of the range beyond the breakout

strategies.rules: 1m/5m / RSI14 > 50, a close above BB(20,1) top, then a close above BB(50,1) top (short mirror under the bottoms, RSI < 50) / stop under the entry candle's low (over its high) / no target: out on a close back under the fast band's top (short: above its bottom)

strategies.rules: 5m / BB(20,2) width at its ~100-bar low, close above the upper band on above-average volume over a rising VWAP (short mirror) / stop at the middle band / half at 2R, rest trailed (ours: 2R), out if 2R not reached in 60 minutes

strategies.name: Oil: first test of yesterday's high/low + 3-candle gap, formation stop, opposite level target

strategies.name: NQ Keltner Pulse: KC 20/2.6 close, stop entry past yesterday's extreme, 2.5 ATR / 1.5%, M15
strategies.rules: M15 Nasdaq / close above KC(20, 2.6) then buy stop at the daily high reference + 0.1 ATR30, valid 46 bars (short mirror) / stop 2.5 x ATR17 / target 1.5% from entry / time exit 30 bars, Friday exit 19:00

strategies.name: Range Filter + RSI 50 + ADX 25, 1 ATR stop, 3R, out under ADX 25, 5m
strategies.rules: 5m / price above the Range Filter, upward counter > 0, RSI > 50, ADX > 25, supportive ATR (short mirror) / stop 1 ATR / target 3R; out when ADX < 25

strategies.name: BVK: EMA 9/21 cross + MACD cross within 5 bars + RSI 50-70, swing stop, 1.5R, 5m
strategies.rules: 5m / EMA9 crosses EMA21 + MACD 12/26/9 crosses its signal + RSI 50-70 (30-50 short), at candle close / stop past the recent swing (or 0.3-0.5%) / target 1.5-2x risk

strategies.name: EMA 9/21 cross over EMA50 + RSI 40-70 / 30-60, 0.5% stop, 1% target, 15m
strategies.rules: 15m / EMA9 crosses above EMA21, close > EMA50, 40 < RSI14 < 70 (short: cross down, close < EMA50, 30 < RSI < 60) / stop 0.5% / target 1.0%

strategies.name: Close over the SMA21 of highs + VWAP + EMA50 + RSI 60, SMA21-low stop, 1.5R, 5m
strategies.rules: 5m / close above SMA21 of highs, above VWAP, above EMA50, RSI > 60 (short mirror with SMA21 of lows, RSI < 40) / stop = close beyond the opposite SMA21 band / target 1.5 x risk

strategies.name: EMA 9/21 cross + RSI 50, 0.5% / 1%, 09:15-15:30 IST, 1H
strategies.rules: 1H / EMA9 crosses EMA21 with RSI > 50 (< 50 short), 09:15-15:30 Asian time / stop 0.5% / target 1.0%

strategies.name: RSI < 40 while EMA9 > EMA21 (RSI > 60 under), 0.5% / 1%, 15m
strategies.rules: 15m / RSI14 < 40 while EMA9 > EMA21 (short RSI > 60 while EMA9 < EMA21) / stop 0.5% / target 1%

strategies.name: Perfect order EMA45/SMA90/SMA180 + Trend Magic flip, SMA90 stop, 1.5R, 5m
strategies.rules: 5m / EMA45 > SMA90 > SMA180 and Trend Magic changes colour (bearish mirror) / stop at SMA90 / target 1.5 x risk

strategies.name: Exp TrendMagic CCI 50 median + ATR 5 colour switch, 3.5 / 7 ATR, 4H
strategies.rules: 4H / TrendMagic (CCI 50 median, ATR 5) colour switch on signal bar 1, reverses on the opposite switch / stop 1000 points / target 2000 points

strategies.name: OneHrStocTrader: BB width band + Stochastic 5/3/5 turn at hours 4 / 0, 95 / 200 pips, H1
strategies.rules: H1 / BB(20,2) spread 56-158 pips; long at hour 4 when %K(5,3,5) < 36 and rising, short at hour 0 when %K > 70 and falling / stop 95 pips / target 200 pips

strategies.name: Williams AO 11/40 zero cross + AC 3 bars + RSI 20, BB width filter, 60 / 90 pips, H1
strategies.rules: H1 / BB spread 40-210 points, RSI20 > 46, AO crosses above 0, AC > 0 three bars and rising, 00-20h (short mirror, RSI < 40) / stop 60 points / target 90 points

strategies.name: EMA 12/26 cross over EMA55 + RSI 35-65 + MACD rising, 0.5% / 1%, 5m
strategies.rules: 5m / EMA12 crosses EMA26, close beyond EMA55, RSI 35-65, MACD line rising (falling short) / stop 0.5% / target 1%

strategies.name: First EMA50 pullback after the EMA50/SMA200 cross, swing-break entry, fib 161.8 target, H1
strategies.rules: H1 / after EMA50-SMA200 cross, first touch of EMA50 (no close beyond SMA200), buy stop at fib 100 / stop beyond fib 0 / target fib 161.8

strategies.name: Heiken Ashi 2 candles + ADX 22 / DI + Stochastic 5/3/3 direction, 12.5 / 12.5 pips, M5
strategies.rules: M5 / two rising HA candles above the HA middle, ADX > 22 with +DI > -DI, Stochastic 5/3/3 rising (short mirror, ADX < 22 as written) / stop 10-15 points / target 10-15 points

strategies.name: Donchian 20 upper-band crawl, buy the middle-band pullback, lower-band stop, out end of day, 15m
strategies.rules: 15m / price crawls the upper Donchian(20) band, buy the pullback to the middle band (reverse for sells) / stop below the lower band / exit end of day or break of the lower band

strategies.name: LV-HP: daily candle colour + Donchian 20 touch, opposite band target, 1:1, 16-20 GMT, M1
strategies.rules: M1, 16:00-20:00 GMT / daily candle green + touch of the lower Donchian band = buy (red + upper = sell) / stop = same distance as the target (1:1) / target the opposite band

strategies.name: MTF Ichimoku: over the cloud and the Kijun on 4H and 1H, 2% / 4%, 12-bar cooldown
strategies.rules: 1H + 4H / price above the cloud and the Kijun-sen on both (below for shorts) / stop 2% / target 4%; 12-bar cooldown

strategies.name: Trader DNA 5-8-13 EMA cross + Parabolic SAR, swing stop, 3R, 1H
strategies.rules: 1H / long: EMA8 crosses above EMA13 with EMA5 above both and the PSAR under the candle (short mirror) / stop recent swing low (high) / target 3R

strategies.name: Trade Pro 50 EMA wick rejection over the 200 EMA, 1 ATR stop, 1.5R, 15m
strategies.rules: 15m / long: price above the 200 MA, a low wick through the 50 MA and the next candle above it (short mirror) / stop 1 x ATR(14) / target 1.5R

strategies.name: Keltner band reversal + EMA 9/21 cross over EMA50, 1.5 / 2 ATR
strategies.rules: 15m / 1H / 4H / long: cross below the lower Keltner band, or EMA9 crosses above EMA21 with price above EMA50 (short mirror) / stop 1.5 x ATR / target 2 x ATR

strategies.name: Williams %R Zone Scalper: -80 / -20 cross + Choppiness < 38.2 + volume, 1.5 / 2 ATR, 5m
strategies.rules: 5m / long: Williams %R(14) crosses above -80 with Choppiness(12) < 38.2 and volume over its 50-bar average (short: crosses below -20) / stop 1.5 x ATR(14) / target 2 x ATR(14)

strategies.name: Dynamic R:R BTC: EMA 20/50 cross + EMA200 + RSI 60/40, swing stop, 2R, 15m
strategies.rules: 15m / long: EMA20 crosses above EMA50, price above EMA200, RSI > 60 (short: below, RSI < 40) / stop last swing low (high) or ATR / targets 1R, 2R, 3R

strategies.name: GoldScalper Pro v8: EMA 8/21/55 + MACD cross + RSI 50-68 + ADX 20, 1 / 5 ATR, break-even, 5m
strategies.rules: 5m (15m compatible) / long: EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55 rising, MACD golden cross, RSI 50-68, ADX >= 20, bullish candle; no entries 00-06 KST (short mirror, RSI 32-50) / stop 1 x ATR / TP1 2 x ATR half + break-even, TP2 5 x ATR, out on the opposite EMA8/21 cross

strategies.name: Happy Hunter: LHLL / HHHL bar, stop entry past Bar1, 1.3 / 1.9 ATR(120), 1H
strategies.rules: 1H / long: signal bar with a lower high and lower low than Bar1 and under the 4 lows before -> buy stop at Bar1 high, 12h expiry (2h if the bar range >= 1.5 ATRH) (short mirror) / stop 1.3 x ATR(120) / target 1.9 x ATR(120), then trail

strategies.name: XAUUSD EMA50/200 trend + pullback to EMA50 with RSI < 30 turning, swing stop, 2R
strategies.rules: 1m / 5m / long: EMA50 above EMA200, pullback near EMA50, RSI(14) under 30 then rising (short mirror over 70) / stop recent swing low (high) / target 1.5R or 2R

strategies.name: Gold Time Precise Model: Asian range break in London's first 3 hours + big-candle patterns, 20 pips, 15m
strategies.rules: 15m / within 3 hours of the London open after a break of the Asian high/low: big bull candle, bear consolidation, bull engulfing - or two big bull candles after an Asian-high break (short mirror) / stop beyond the first candle of the setup / target +20 pips (or half at +10 and trail)

strategies.name: US30 Parabolic SAR flip + close beyond the last opposite dot, EMA100, 25 / 50 pips, 1m
strategies.rules: 1m, after 13:00 London / long: price above EMA100, SAR flips to buy, a close above the last sell-SAR dot -> enter next candle (short mirror) / stop 25 pips / target 50 pips, break-even at 30-40

strategies.name: WHS Z-Score: re-cross of -2 / +2 with the 100 MA slope, target the 20 MA, 20-bar exit, 15m
strategies.rules: 15m / long: 100 MA rising, Z-Score(20) falls under -2.0 and rises back above (short mirror over +2.0 with the MA falling) / stop entry candle low (high) or ATR / target the 20 MA, out after 20 candles

strategies.name: Pieper Histo Breakout: HVR < 0.5 + inside / narrow-range bar, close beyond within 4 bars, 2R, 1H
strategies.rules: hourly (also daily / weekly) / HVR < 0.5 and an inside or narrow-range signal candle; long on a close above its high within 4 candles (short below its low) / stop the other end of the signal candle / target 2R, break-even at 1R

strategies.name: News 1m: impulse candle, entry after the 3-minute correction, stop past it, target the impulse extreme
strategies.rules: 1m / after the news impulse candle wait for the 3-5 minute correction and enter in the impulse direction after the 3rd-4th minute close / stop beyond the entry extreme / target a newly formed extreme

strategies.name: News fade: release spike + reversal candle, wick break, stop the spike, target the pre-release close, 15-min exit, 5m
strategies.rules: 5m (macro) / first candle after the release closes as a reversal (shooting star / engulfing / inside-bar rejection) on 3-5x volume; enter on the break of its opposite wick / stop beyond the spike extreme / T1 VWAP, T2 prior close (gap fill); exit if nothing within 15 minutes

strategies.name: CPI 08:30-09:00 ET range breakout, stop at the midpoint, target the prior day's high / low
strategies.rules: 08:30 ET release, no trades until 09:00; trade the breakout of the 08:30-09:00 range / stop just beyond the range midpoint / target a prior-day key level

strategies.name: freqtrade Hacklemore: RMI + MACD + SAR + lower-BB touch 2-10 bars ago, -8.5% / 1.5%, 5m
strategies.rules: 5m, long only / up-trend (12-bar high rising), RMI(20,5) >= 55 and rising, MACD > signal with positive histogram, low touched the lower BB(20) 2-10 bars ago, two higher closes, SAR under price / stoploss -8.5% / minimal_roi 15% -> 2.5% after 5 min -> 1.5% after 10 min

strategies.name: Tricolor M1: EMA 63/102/165 stack + Stochastic 30/6/18 under 10 + 15/3/9 crossing 20, 5 / 10 pips
strategies.rules: M1, European session: EMA63 > EMA102 > EMA165, Stochastic(30,6,18) entered below 10, Stochastic(15,3,9) crosses 20 upward -> buy (mirror -> sell) / stop 5 points + spread / target 10 points + spread

strategies.name: ADX(14) crossing its MA9 + MACD 5/25/9 zero side, 30 / 60 pips, opposite-signal exit, M15
strategies.rules: M15 EUR/USD: ADX(14) crosses above its MA(9); MACD(5,25,9) positive -> buy, negative -> sell / stop 30 points / target 60 points; opposite signal closes

strategies.name: 10 points: MACD 13/26/9 histogram side + Stochastic 5/3/3 back over 20 / under 80, local-extreme stop, 10 pips, M1
strategies.rules: M1: MACD(13,26,9) histogram > 0 and Stochastic(5,3,3) rises back above 20 -> buy; histogram < 0 and stochastic falls back under 80 -> sell / stop 1 point beyond the nearest local low/high / target 10 points

strategies.name: Ranger: Parabolic SAR 0.04/0.1 + Stochastic 5/5/5 cross under 25 / over 75, local stop <= 20 pips, 2.5R, M15
strategies.rules: M15+: Stochastic(5,5,5) lines cross below 25 and turn up with Parabolic SAR(0.04,0.1) under price -> buy next open (mirror over 75 -> sell) / stop at the latest local low/high, max 20 points / target 2-3x the stop; also out when the stochastic reaches the opposite zone

strategies.name: PinkFlint news straddle: +/-20 pips from the price 5 min before, stop 30, target 5 pips, M5
strategies.rules: M5, news: 5 minutes before the release buy stop and sell stop 20 points from price / stop 30 points / take profit +5 points (break-even after +5)

strategies.name: Stochastic 14/3/3 %K>%D (<=80) + MACD over signal, 3-bar stop, exit when either fails, 15m
strategies.rules: daily / 15m: first close with slow %K > %D, %K <= 80 and MACD(12,26,9) > signal -> long (mirror, %K >= 20 -> short) / stop beyond the lowest low (highest high) of the entry bar and the 2 before / exit on the first close where either condition fails, or session close

strategies.name: EMA ribbon 2-15 crossing ribbon 44-74, M1 12 / 6 pips, M5 18 / 16 pips
strategies.rules: M1/M5 majors: EMA 2..15 (pink) crosses the EMA 44..74 (green) -> trade in the cross direction / stop M1 12 points, M5 18 points / target M1 5-7 points, M5 12-20 points

strategies.name: RSI(7) back over 20 / under 80, entry-candle stop, out at RSI 50, 1-minute
strategies.rules: 1m: RSI(7) dips below 20 and moves back above -> buy; above 80 and back below -> sell / stop a few pips beyond the entry candle or swing / take profit as RSI approaches 50 or at S/R

strategies.name: Stochastic 14/3/3 cross under 20 / over 80, swing stop, out at the opposite extreme, 1-minute
strategies.rules: 1m: %K crosses above %D with both below 20 -> buy; below %D with both above 80 -> sell / stop a few pips away or beyond the swing / take profit when the stochastic reaches the opposite extreme

strategies.name: 5m EMA20 pullback + Stochastic RSI turn from 20 on the VWAP side, swing stop, 1.25R, 08-12 NY
strategies.rules: 5m, 08:00-12:00 EST: above VWAP, price above the 20 EMA pulls back to it, a bullish candle closes back above with Stochastic RSI turning up from below 20 -> buy (sells below VWAP) / stop just below the recent swing low / target 1:1-1:1.5 (5-10 pips); exit on a clear close on the other side of the EMA

strategies.name: MA Crossover ADX: EMA39 rising 2 bars + ADX33 > 22 + DI, 40 / 90 pips, H1
strategies.rules: H1: EMA(39) rising over the last 2 steps, previous close above the previous EMA, ADX(33) > 22, +DI > -DI -> buy (mirror -> sell); opposite conditions close / stop 400 points / target 900 points

strategies.name: MA Price Cross: close crosses SMA160, 20 / 60 pips (1:3), 01-22
strategies.rules: 1m (doc table) / 1h (code): close crosses the 160 MA upward -> buy, downward -> sell, entries 01:00-22:00 / stop 200 points / target 600 points

strategies.name: Connors S&P: over MA20 + RSI(3) < 30, break of the prior high within 2 bars, prior-bar-range stop, BE at 1R
strategies.rules: 20-minute bars (5/10/15 also): above the 20 MA with RSI(3) < 30 -> buy 1 tick over the previous bar's high on the next 2 bars only (mirror for shorts) / risk no more than the previous bar's size / half off at 1R, stop to break-even, trail the rest

strategies.name: STC 23/50/10 cross of 25/75 + EMA35/EMA200 trend, 1:1, opposite reverses
strategies.rules: 3h: STC(23/50/10) crosses above 25 with EMA35 > EMA200 and close > EMA35 -> long (mirror: below 75) / stop 400 ticks / target 400 ticks, opposite signal reverses

strategies.name: STC(12,26,50) turn + UT ATR(5)x3.5 trail regime + SMA200, trail stop, 2 ATR(5) target
strategies.rules: 4h: first STC(12,26,50) up-turn, UT ATR(5)x3.5 regime not bearish, close >= SMA200 -> long (mirror) / stop = the trailing-stop line at entry / target entry +/- 2 x ATR(5), exit when the regime flips

strategies.name: Kijun 20 cross bar closing in its top / bottom 25%, 1.5 ATR stop, 15 pips, Kijun exit, 15m
strategies.rules: 15m: open under / close over Kijun(20) with %R(1) >= -25 -> long (mirror <= -75) / stop 1.5 x ATR(14) / target 15 pips; exit on a close back across the Kijun

strategies.name: Kijun 20 loopback: open under / close over the Kijun, 1.5 ATR stop, 10 pips, Kijun exit, 1H
strategies.rules: 1h: open under / close over Kijun(20) -> long (mirror) / stop 1.5 x ATR(14) / target 10 pips; exit on a close back across the Kijun

strategies.name: Kalman-smoothed Hull cross + WaveTrend 10/21 cross on the same bar, 5% / 10%, 1H
strategies.rules: 1h: Kalman-smoothed Hull lines cross and WaveTrend 10/21 crosses the same way on the same bar / stop 5% / target 10%, opposite signal closes

strategies.name: MFI(3) = 100 / 0 + momentum body over / under SMA80, 00:00-bar stop -3%, 2.2R, 5m
strategies.rules: 5m: previous MFI(3) = 100, bullish bar with body > 50% of range, close > SMA80 -> long (mirror MFI 0) / stop the 00:00 UTC bar's low - 3% (high + 3%) / target 2.2R

strategies.name: Asian 19:00-01:00 UTC range fade from 04:00, one per session, 1:1, 1H
strategies.rules: 1h: 19:00-01:00 range; from 04:00 a close under the Asian low -> long, over the high -> short, one per session / stop 300 ticks / target 300 ticks

strategies.name: Sproule: price and previous bar on one side of EMA100, EMA trailing stop, 100 pips, 1H
strategies.rules: 1h: price above EMA100 and previous low above it -> long (mirror) / stop at the EMA100, moved every hour / target 100 pips

strategies.name: EURUSD SMA5/SMA100 cross confirmed one candle later, 150 / 300 pips, 4H
strategies.rules: 4h / daily EURUSD: SMA5 crosses SMA100, one more candle confirms -> enter / stop 150 pips / target 300 pips

strategies.name: Richbugger: 20 pips past the 4H EMA60(HL2) and over the 1H EMA60, 30-pip stop, 1H-EMA exit
strategies.rules: 4h + 1h: price >= 20 pips past the 4H EMA60 (median price) and beyond the 1H EMA60 -> enter / stop 30 pips, then trailed on the 1H EMA / exit on a cross back through the 1H EMA

strategies.name: Centred 227-bar close extreme breakout, Donchian-20 stop, 5-pip trail, 30 pips, 10-23 CET, EURUSD 1H
strategies.rules: EURUSD 1h: close crosses the last centred 227-bar close extreme, 10:00-23:00 / stop 20-bar Donchian low (high), 5-point close trail / target 30 points

strategies.name: DAX 3 up bars closing 12:00 long / 3 down bars 16:00 short, 30 / 45 points, flat 21:00, 1H
strategies.rules: DAX 1h: 3 up bars ending at 12:00 -> buy, 3 down bars ending at 16:00 -> sell / stop 30 points / target 45 points, flat 21:00

strategies.name: 20/200 pips: Open[2]-Open[7] > 7 pips at 18:00 GMT, 20-pip target, 200-pip stop, EURUSD H1
strategies.rules: EURUSD H1: at 18:00 GMT, Open[2] - Open[7] beyond 7 pips -> trade with it, one a day / stop 200 pips / target 20 pips

strategies.name: freqtrade BinHV45: BB40 lower-band capitulation bar, -5% / +1.25%, 1m, long
strategies.rules: 1m long: BB40/2 width > 0.8%, 1-bar move > 1.75%, tail < 0.25 x width, close under the previous lower band -> buy / stop -5% / target +1.25%

strategies.name: DAX Reversal Catcher: BB 1.5 lower poke + higher bar + TEMA21>50 + VWAP cross, upper-band exit, 15:00 flat
strategies.rules: DAX 30m long: previous low under BB(20,1.5), higher high / low closing over the prior high, TEMA21 > TEMA50, close crosses VWAP -> buy / stop the previous low / exit over the upper band, TEMA cross down or 15:00 CET

strategies.name: DAX trend: over SMA200 + MACD > 0 state from 09:00, 1% / 3%, flat 21:00, H4
strategies.rules: DAX 4h: close > SMA200 and MACD > 0 from 09:00 -> buy (mirror short) / stop 1% / target 3%, flat 21:00

strategies.name: MACD(5,13,1) change 20:00 -> 04:00 >= 50 points, entry at the 08:00 open, 30 / 30+45 pips, BE, 4H
strategies.rules: 4h: MACD(5,13,1) on the 04:00 candle minus the previous 20:00 candle >= +50 -> long at the 08:00 open (<= -50 short) / stop 30 pips / targets 30 and 45 pips, half out and break-even at +30

strategies.name: SMA48 side + ATR(7) crossing its 30-bar average, 25 / 110 points, BE, USDJPY H4
strategies.rules: USDJPY 4h: above SMA48 and ATR(7) crosses up its 30-MA -> buy (below + cross down -> sell) / stop >= 25 points, break-even at 25-30 / target 100-120 points, reverse-signal exit

strategies.name: SSMA90 + WPR(11) < -85 + CCI(12) hook from under -100 + ATR filter, 12.5 / 50 points
strategies.rules: M5-H1: above SSMA90, WPR(11) < -85, CCI(12) turns up from under -100, ATR(14) > 0.002 -> buy (mirror) / stop 10-15 points / target >= 50 points, reverse-signal exit

strategies.name: RVI(10) signal cross + rising RSI(14) and StdDev(20), 35 / 100 points, BE at 30, H1
strategies.rules: H1+: RVI(10) crosses its signal with RSI(14) and StdDev(20) rising -> buy next open (mirror) / stop >= 35 points, break-even after 30 / target 100 points

strategies.name: Close beyond the Kumo and two Alligators + CCI50 > 50 + Stoch > 50, Alligator exit, yen pairs H1
strategies.rules: H1+ yen pairs: close above the Kumo and both Alligators (13/8/5, 39/24/15), CCI(50) > 50, Stoch(14,3,3) > 50 -> buy next candle (mirror) / stop 35-50 points, BE after 30 / target 100-150; exit on a close beyond an Alligator line

strategies.name: SMA233 high / low channel close beyond +15 points, stop at the channel, first ladder target +89
strategies.rules: M30+: close above SMA233(high) + 15 points -> buy (below SMA233(low) - 15 -> sell) / stop at the channel line / targets +89, +144, +233, +362 points

strategies.name: DAX 08:00-09:05 CET range breakout with the EMA50 bias, range stop, 2R, 5m
strategies.rules: DAX 5m: break of the 08:00-09:05 CET range in the EMA50 direction / stop the other side of the range / target 2R

strategies.name: Warrior pullback: 5+ green ramp, dip to EMA9 / VWAP, first new-high candle, pullback-low stop, HOD target, 5m
strategies.rules: 5m stocks: 5+ green candle ramp, pullback to the 9-EMA or VWAP, first candle making a new high -> buy / stop the pullback low / target the high of day

strategies.name: EMA50 cross, stop 1 x ADR(14), target 2 x ADR
strategies.rules: M15 / M30 / H1: price crosses EMA50 -> trade its way / stop 1 x ADR / target 2 x ADR

strategies.name: EIA Wednesday 10:15-10:30 ET box breakout after 10:30, midpoint stop, 2R
strategies.rules: CL on EIA Wednesdays: box = 10:15-10:30 ET high / low, wait 30 s after 10:30, break of the box -> enter / stop the box midpoint / target 2:1 or 3:1

strategies.name: Engulfing / pin bar breakout, stop entry past the signal candle, candle stop, 5R long / 4R short, 1H
strategies.rules: 1H: hammer / bullish engulfing -> buy stop over its high (shooting star / bearish engulfing -> sell stop under its low) / stop the signal candle's other end / target 1:5 long, 1:4 short

strategies.name: 1h liquidity swings: low reclaims the pivot-5 low over SMA50, 0.5% buffer stop, 2R, close-through exit
strategies.rules: 1H: uptrend + low crosses back over the last pivot-5 low and close under the pivot high -> long (mirror short) / stop support - 0.5% / target 2R; out on a close through the level

strategies.name: 50 Pips A Day: 07:00 GMT hourly candle straddle, 15 / 50 pips, Mon-Fri
strategies.rules: 1H: buy stop at the 07:00 GMT candle high, sell stop at its low, OCO, Mon-Fri / stop 15 pips / target 50 pips; closed at the session end

strategies.name: Bollinger 20/2 close breakout + RSI 50, 2% / 4%, 4H
strategies.rules: 4H: close over the upper BB(20,2) and RSI(14) > 50 -> long (mirror short) / stop 2% / target 4% (2:1)

strategies.name: SMA10/30 cross + EMA5 filter, 1% / 2%, 5m
strategies.rules: 5m: SMA10 crosses over SMA30 with close > EMA5 -> long (mirror short) / stop 1% / target 2%

strategies.name: Nifty EMA 5/10 cross + Stochastic 14/3/3 over 20 / under 80, 5 / 10 points, stoch exit, 1m
strategies.rules: 1m: EMA5 crosses over EMA10 and Stochastic(14,3,3) rises over 20 -> buy (mirror under 80 -> sell) / stop 5 points / target 10 points; out at stochastic overbought / oversold

strategies.name: Forex Master: EMA20(RSI10) up / EMA30(RSI30) down through 50, 50 / 50 pips, opposite exit, 1H
strategies.rules: 1H EURUSD: EMA20 of RSI(10) crosses over 50 -> long; EMA30 of RSI(30) crosses under 50 -> short / stop 50 pips / target 50 pips; opposite signal closes

strategies.name: EMA9 breakaway: low 5 pips off the EMA9 + close over the prior high, prior-candle stop, 2R, M15
strategies.rules: M15 GBPUSD: prior candle closes over EMA9, this candle's low >= 5 pips over EMA9 and close > prior high -> buy (mirror sell) / stop prior low - 1 pip - spread / target 2 x stop

strategies.name: MACD 12/26/9 cross + confirming candle, 125 / 30 pips, 6-bar exit, H1
strategies.rules: H1 GBPUSD: MACD(12,26,9) crosses its signal, next candle confirms (bullish, MACD still over) -> enter at its close (mirror) / stop 125 pips / target 30 pips; closed after 6 hourly candles

strategies.name: Kathy Lien Pure Fade: 3-SD touch + RSI 30/70, close back in the 2-1 SD zone, swing stop, BE 1R, 2R, 1H
strategies.source: Book (Kathy Lien, High Probability Trading Setups) via forexar.yolasite.com

strategies.name: Diamond top / bottom: close through the right-side line, stop the last inner swing, full-height target, 15m/30m

strategies.rules: Diamond top / bottom (Trader Dhana, Facebook reel 'Bearish Diamond Pattern', sent by the user - task 15), intraday 15m / 30m. strategies.name: 3-touch trend-line liquidity grab + FVG + BOS, entry back in the FVG, grab stop, 2R

strategies.rules: TheTrader's Villa 'Liquidity Trendline Break + FVG' (Facebook reel, task 16), 5m - 1h. Bullish mirror (rising line with 3+ touches, sweep under it, bullish FVG + BOS over the last swing high, buy back in the FVG). Differs from the user's gap method (tal_gap) by the 3-touch line and the sweep before the gap. Ours: l

strategies.source: TikTok (The Trader's Guide post, sent by the user; task 38)

strategies.name: RSI range shift: up trend RSI dips to 40-45 and turns / down trend 55-60, swing stop, 2R
strategies.source: TikTok (Trading Data, sent by the user; task tal1411rsi)
strategies.rules: Trading Data (TikTok, task tal1411rsi): in a trend RSI does not reach 30 / 70 - in a down trend it lives in ~20-60, in an up trend in ~40-80, so 'buy at 30' fails in a down trend. Rule (b): in an up trend buy when RSI(14) dips to 40-45 and turns up; in a down trend sell when RSI rises to 55-60 and turns down. Trend (ours, from the same day's Market Structure video): close over EMA50 and EMA21 over EMA50 (mirror). No stop / target in the video - ours: stop beyond the 10-bar swing extreme, target 2R. agents/indicators rsi_regime.

strategies.name: RSI 60-40 setup A: EMA21>50 trend, RSI ~40 turn near EMA21 + confirm candle, EMA50 stop, last-high target, EMA21 trail
strategies.source: TikTok (Market Structure 'RSI 60-40 Setup', sent by the user; task tal1411rsi)
strategies.rules: Market Structure (TikTok 'RSI 60-40 Setup', task tal1411rsi 08:58), 15m / 1h / 4h. Trend up = close over EMA21 and EMA50 and EMA21 over EMA50. Entry A (pullback): RSI(14) near 40 (<= 45 on the previous bar) and turning up, price near EMA21/50 (the low within 0.5 ATR of EMA21 or under it, close over EMA50), on a confirmation candle (close over the previous high). Stop under EMA50 (ours: EMA50 - 0.2 ATR); target 1 = the last swing high (ours: the whole position at the last confirmed 5-bar swing high, at least 1R away), trail under EMA21 (exit on a close under EMA21). Short = mirror (RSI near 60 turning down).

strategies.name: RSI 60-40 setup B: RSI > 60 + strong candle through the swing high, EMA21 stop, 2.5R, EMA21 trail
strategies.source: TikTok (Market Structure 'RSI 60-40 Setup', sent by the user; task tal1411rsi)
strategies.rules: Market Structure 'RSI 60-40 Setup' entry B (breakout), 15m / 1h / 4h: in the up trend (as SC179) RSI(14) over 60 and a strong candle (body >= 0.6 of its true range, true range >= 1 ATR) closes over the last swing high -> buy; stop under EMA21; target 2-3R (ours: 2.5R) with the trail under EMA21 (exit on a close under it). Short = mirror (RSI under 40, close under the last swing low).

strategies.name: RSI14 divergence with the EMA200 trend, then RSI 50 cross, divergence-extreme stop, 2R
strategies.source: TikTok (The Trader's Guide '5 RSI ideas'; task tal1411rsi)
strategies.rules: The Trader's Guide ('5 RSI ideas', task tal1411rsi 09:16): RSI divergence only in the direction of the big trend, confirmed by RSI crossing 50. Long: close over EMA200, a confirmed swing low (5 bars) lower than the previous one with a HIGHER RSI(14) at it (bullish divergence), then RSI crosses over 50 within 20 bars -> buy. Short = mirror (under EMA200, bearish divergence, RSI under 50). No stop / target in the video - ours: stop under the divergence low (over the high), target 2R.

strategies.name: Close beyond both the VWAP and EMA20, exit on a close back beyond both, 1.5 ATR stop

Ours: EMA 20 (the video does not say the length), the first close beyond both (onset), stop 1.5 ATR (no stop in the video), no fixed target - the exit rule. Tick volume VWAP (CFDs, noted).

strategies.name: EMA50>200 trend, 0.5-0.786 pullback, entry on the EMA9 reclaim, pullback-low stop, swing-high / 2R
strategies.rules: The Trader's Guide (TikTok, task tal1411vwap (2)): in a trend (EMA50 over EMA200) wait for a pullback into the 0.5-0.786 zone of the last move (confirmed 5-bar swing low -> swing high), enter only after the price closes back over EMA9; stop under the pullback low; target the swing high / 2R (ours: the swing high when it is >= 1R away, else 2R). strategies.name: EMA9/21 cross over VWAP + ADX > 20, stop entry over the confirm high, candle stop, 2R
strategies.rules: The Trader's Guide 'ADX 80%' (TikTok, task tal1411set2 (1)): EMA9 crosses over EMA21, price over EMA9 and over the VWAP, ADX(14) over 20 on the confirmation candle -> buy on a break of the confirmation candle's high (within 3 bars); stop under the confirmation candle (or EMA21, the lower), target 2R (the video: 1.5-2R or exit on the cross back - we also exit on EMA9 crossing back under EMA21). strategies.name: Swing-low sweep and reclaim, sweep-low stop, target the previous swing high, gold 15m
strategies.rules: sphula (TikTok, gold 15m, task tal1411set2 (2)): price runs under a previous swing low and comes back over it - buy on the reclaim (the close back over the low) or on the retest of the zone; stop under the sweep low; target the previous swing high. Sell = mirror. Ours: swings of 5 bars (agents/indicators liquidity), entry at the reclaim close, target = the last confirmed swing high when it is >= 1R away (else 2R). Differs from SC151 (pivot-5 + SMA50 filter, 2R) and TV11 (the previous DAY's low) by the swing-high target and no trend filter.

strategies.name: EMA20/50 direction + buyer/seller pressure flip (tick volume), swing stop, 2R
strategies.rules: ProTrippa 'Forget MACD & RSI' (TikTok, task tal1411set3 (1)): two moving averages give the direction (ours: EMA20 over EMA50 and both rising = up); enter only when the buyers-vs-sellers pressure oscillator flips to the side of the trend (agents/indicators buy_sell_pressure: close location x tick volume - CFDs have no real volume, noted). No stop / target in the video - ours: stop beyond the 10-bar swing, target 2R, exit when the pressure flips back.

strategies.name: MFI14 back over 20 above EMA200 / under 80 below, swing stop, 2R
strategies.rules: Quant Tactics (TikTok, crypto results 300%+ probably exaggerated; task tal1411set3 (2)): Money Flow Index (14) - buy when it leaves the zone under 20 (crosses back over 20) in an up trend, sell when it crosses back under 80 in a down trend. Trend (ours) = EMA50 vs EMA200 (the dip under 20 often takes the price itself under a long average). Tick volume (CFDs). No stop / target - ours: stop beyond the 10-bar swing, target 2R. Differs from SC129 (MFI(3) = 100 / 0 momentum).

strategies.name: Broken S/R level (2+ tests) retest + EMA50 slope + RSI 50 confirmation, level stop, next-level target
strategies.rules: Flux Charts 'S&R Strategy' (TikTok, task tal1411set4 (1)): automatic S/R levels (swings tested 2+ times); enter on the retest of a level that broke, only with a second indicator's confirmation (ours: EMA50 slope in the trade's direction AND RSI(14) on the right side of 50); stop beyond the level; target the next level. strategies.name: Support held 3 tests, break, retest and rejection, pre-break swing stop, next level / 2R
strategies.rules: Lima Signal (TikTok, task tal1411set4 09:31) break and retest: a support that held 3 pullbacks; a candle closes under it; price comes back to it from below and is rejected -> sell; stop over the swing high before the break; target the established low (ours: 2R - the video's 'established low' is the next support, taken when it is >= 1R away). Buy = mirror (resistance held 3 times, broken up, retested from above). agents/indicators sr_levels.

strategies.name: EMA 9/21/50/100/200 graded trend: strong -> EMA50 pullback, normal -> EMA21, 2R
strategies.source: TikTok (The Trader's Guide EMA 9/21/50/100/200; task tal1411set4)
strategies.rules: The Trader's Guide (TikTok, task tal1411set4 (2)): the order of EMA 9/21/50/100/200 grades the trend - all five in order = strong trend, pullbacks go to EMA50/100; a normal trend (price over EMA200, 9 > 21 > 50) pulls back to EMA21. strategies.name: Falling trend-line touch short, stop 0.3 ATR over the line, 4R, US500 1m
strategies.rules: Dan-Chi (TikTok, US500 1-minute, task tal1411set4 09:37): sell at the touch of a falling trend line with a tight stop over it and a far target. Ours: automatic line through the last two lower confirmed swing highs (agents/ indicators trendlines, pivots 5), the high reaches the line and the candle closes under it -> sell; stop = the line + 0.3 ATR; target 4R ('far' - ours). Buy = mirror on a rising support line.

strategies.rules: Market Structure 'pullbacks EMA20/50 + RSI' (TikTok, task tal1411set6 (2)): EMA20 over EMA50 and RSI(14) over 50 -> buy when the price touches EMA20 (the low reaches it, the close stays over it) with RSI still over 50; exit when EMA20 closes under EMA50 or the price closes under EMA50. Sell = mirror. No stop in the video - ours: EMA50 - 0.5 ATR, no fixed target. Differs from SC057 (needs an engulfing / pin bar and 2R).

strategies.name: Previous-session POC retest after acceptance, rejection candle, 0.5 ATR stop, 2R
strategies.source: TikTok (Market Structure '8 types of retest'; task tal1411set6)
strategies.rules: Market Structure '8 types of retest' (TikTok, task tal1411set6 (3)) - the POC kind: once the price has closed over the previous session's POC (bullish POC), the first return to it that is rejected (the low reaches the POC, the close is back over it and over the open = rejection candle) -> buy; mirror for a bearish POC. strategies.name: RSI divergence, then a structure break on expanding volume, divergence-low stop, 2R
strategies.source: TikTok (Market Structure 'divergence is a warning'; task tal1411set6)
strategies.rules: Market Structure 'RSI divergence is a warning, not an entry' (TikTok, task tal1411set6 (4)): after a bullish RSI(14) divergence (lower swing low, higher RSI - pivots of 5 bars, known 5 bars late) wait for a break of structure - a close over the last swing high - with expanding volume (tick volume over its 20-bar average; a feed without volume passes) -> buy; bearish mirror. Valid 30 bars after the divergence. No stop / target in the video - ours: stop under the divergence low, target 2R.

strategies.name: Bollinger 20/2 poke back inside within the value area / POC / HVN, target the middle band
strategies.source: TikTok (Flux Charts 'Bollinger + Volume Profile'; task tal1411set6)
strategies.rules: Flux Charts 'Bollinger + Volume Profile' (TikTok, task tal1411set6 (5)): a candle outside the lower Bollinger band (20, 2) inside a high-volume area / the POC that closes back inside the bands -> buy; target the middle band (variant: the other band). Sell = mirror at the upper band. Ours: 'high-volume area' = within the previous session's value area (VAL..VAH) or within 0.5 ATR of its POC or an HVN (tick-volume profile, noted); entry at the close back inside; stop 0.3 ATR beyond the poke's extreme; target the middle band.

strategies.name: Symmetric / ascending / descending triangle breakout, opposite-line stop, height target
strategies.rules: '16 chart patterns' (TikTok, task tal1411set6 (6)) - the triangles, which the library did not have: symmetric (falling highs + rising lows), ascending (flat highs + rising lows) and descending (falling highs + flat lows). Buy on a close over the upper line, sell on a close under the lower line; stop on the other side of the triangle at the breakout bar (the opposite line); target = the triangle's height at its start projected from the break (the classic measured move). Ours: lines + pattern from agents/indicators trendlines (pivots 4); ascending only long, descending only short, symmetric both.

strategies.name: Triple top / bottom neckline break, extreme stop, height target
strategies.rules: '16 chart patterns' (TikTok, task tal1411set6 (6)): triple top = three swing highs within 1 ATR of each other with the two lows between them (the neckline = the lower of those lows); sell on a close under the neckline; stop over the highest of the three tops; target = the pattern's height under the neckline. Triple bottom = mirror. Ours: swings of 4 bars (known 4 bars late), tops within 1 ATR, the pattern must break within 40 bars of the third top.

strategies.name: Bull / bear flag: 3-ATR pole, 5-20 bar flag under 50%, flag break, pole target
strategies.rules: '16 chart patterns' (TikTok, task tal1411set6 (6)) - flags: a pole (a move of >= 3 ATR within <= 10 bars) then a flag of 5-20 bars that retraces under 50% of the pole; buy on a close over the flag's high (bull flag), stop under the flag's low, target = the pole's length from the breakout (measured move). Bear flag = mirror. Ours: the flag = the bars since the pole's extreme; ATR(14) at the pole.

strategies.name: Daily pivot bias: over P, first pullback to P, stop S1 / 1 ATR, target R1

strategies.rules: Ezekiel Chew (TikTok, task tal1411set6 (7)): daily pivot points as support / resistance and trend - price over P = bullish. strategies.name: 20-bar box breakout with >= 80% buyer share of the bar's tick volume, mid stop, box-height target
strategies.rules: Flux Charts 'Easy Strategy, two free indicators' (TikTok, task tal1411set6 (8)): breakout from a range box confirmed by the buyers' share of the breakout candle's volume (83% buyers in the video). strategies.name: First touch of the previous session's POC, reverse entry, 1 ATR stop, 2R

strategies.name: Over EMA50 + DI cross + ADX > 20 rising, swing stop, 2R
strategies.source: TikTok (The Trader's Guide ADX + DI + EMA50; task tal1411set6)

strategies.name: ICT Judas swing of the Asian range at London / NY, order-block re-entry, sweep stop, Asian-range target

strategies.rules: Joe Ross 'Gimmee bar' (LuxAlgo classic bar setups https://www.luxalgo.com/library/concept/classic-bar-setups/ ), sideways markets only: Bollinger 20/2; sell setup = the bar's high at / over the upper band and the close under its open -> sell stop 1 tick under that bar's low (next 2 bars); buy mirror at the lower band. Ours: sideways = ADX(14) < 20 (the source suggests an ADX filter); stop the setup bar's other extreme; target the middle band (no target in the source).

strategies.name: Momentum Pinball: RSI3 of the daily change < 30 / > 70, first-hour breakout, first-hour stop, next-morning exit
strategies.rules: Momentum Pinball (Raschke & Connors; WH SelfInvest https://www.whselfinvest.de/en-de/trading-platform/free-trading-strategies/tradingsystem/48-momentum-pinball-trading-indicator-raschke-linda-connors-larry ), daily signal, intraday entry: RSI(3) of the 1-day change closes under 30 -> the next day buy stop over the first hour's high (stop = the first hour's low); over 70 -> sell stop under the first hour's low. Exit: a loser is closed before the close; a winner is held overnight and closed the next morning. Ours on intraday bars (15m / 1h): UTC days, the first hour = 00:00-01:00 UTC; entry = the first close beyond that hour's range; time exit after 24 hours (= 'the next morning').

strategies.name: Elder Triple Screen: 4x-TF MACD-hist slope + Force Index EMA2 pullback + prior-high break, 2R
strategies.rules: Elder Triple Screen (forexop https://forexop.com/strategy/simple-triple-screen/ ), e.g. Daily / H4 / H1: screen 1 = the trend from the MACD-histogram slope of a 4x higher timeframe (rising = long only); screen 2 = Force Index EMA(2) under 0 on this timeframe (a pullback); screen 3 = buy stop over the previous bar's high (Elder's rule) -> the first close over it; stop under the low of the signal / previous bar; target 2R (no fixed target in the source - ours). Short = mirror.

strategies.name: Raschke Anti 3/10 oscillator pullback re-cross, pullback-low stop, cross-back exit
strategies.rules: Raschke 'Anti', 3/10 oscillator version (MQL5 article https://www.mql5.com/en/articles/24280 , H4): fast = SMA3 - SMA10, slow = SMA16(fast); the slow line over 0 opens the long window; the fast line pulls back to / under the slow line and then crosses back over it (the first cross) with a close over the previous close -> buy at the next open; stop the lowest low of the pullback; exit when the fast line crosses back under. Short = mirror. Differs from FR11 (the stochastic hook).

strategies.name: Larry Williams Smash Day: close under the prior low at an 8-bar low close, buy over its high, 3-bar exit
strategies.rules: Larry Williams Smash Day (Rogue Quant https://roguequant.substack.com/p/i-backtested-larry-williams-trading ), daily: a bar that closes under the previous low AND is the lowest close of the last 8 bars -> buy stop over that bar's high on the next bar (the first close over it within 1 bar); sell = mirror. The source tests it as stop-and- reverse; Williams' own exits: a stop / the first profitable open - ours: stop at the smash bar's low (high), exit after 3 bars, no target. Differs from QB13 (the HIDDEN smash day).

strategies.name: Weinstein stage 1->2 (SMA150 slope, 10-bar highs) on 1.8x volume + RSI >= 50, 2 / 6 ATR, SMA exit
strategies.rules: Stan Weinstein stage 1 -> 2 transition (MQL5 https://www.mql5.com/en/articles/22746 ), daily: SMA150 for the 30-week line; slope = (SMA - SMA 10 bars ago) / 10 / close, rising > +0.0001; stage 2 = rising SMA, price over it and the last 10 highs over the 10 before; long when stage 2 begins on tick volume > 1.8x its 20-bar average (a feed without volume passes) with RSI(14) >= 50; short = the stage 3 -> 4 mirror. Stop 2 ATR(14), target 3x the stop; early exit on a close back across the SMA.

strategies.rules: Average High-Low Range + IBS reversal (TradingView https://in.tradingview.com/script/BTwOiV1h-Average-High-Low-Range-IBS-Reversal-Strategy ), daily, long only: the close under (10-bar highest high - 2.5 x the 20-bar average of high - low) on 2 bars in a row and IBS = (close - low) / (high - low) under 0.2 -> buy; exit on a close over the previous bar's high.
